refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval
refresh_interval.description: Seconds between automatic checks. Opening the panel also refreshes when the data is older than this.

mark_read_on_open.label: Mark as read when opened
mark_read_on_open.description: Clicking a notification marks it as read in Basecamp as well as opening it.

open_command.label: Open command
open_command.description: How a notification is opened. {url} is replaced with the Basecamp link. The command is run directly, not through a shell, so pipes and && do not work; point it at a script if you need those. Change this if your browser opens in the background: a plugin cannot hand it the focus token the shell uses.

show_count.label: Show unread count
show_count.description: Show the number of unread notifications next to the logo in the bar.

account.cycle_tooltip: Left click for the next account, right click for the previous one

error.version: Could not determine the Basecamp CLI version
error.mark_read: Could not mark the notification as read
error.timeout: the Basecamp CLI did not answer in time
error.spawn: could not run the Basecamp CLI
error.truncated: the Basecamp CLI response was too large to read
error.parse: could not read the Basecamp CLI response
error.check: Could not check the Basecamp CLI: {reason}
error.no_terminal: Could not open a terminal. Run `basecamp auth login` yourself.

setup.missing_title: The Basecamp CLI is not installed
setup.missing_body: This plugin reads your notifications through the Basecamp CLI. Install it, then sign in.
setup.outdated_title: Basecamp CLI 0.9 or newer is required
setup.outdated_body: Version {version} is installed. Older versions cannot mark notifications as read.
setup.signin_body: Signing in opens a terminal and your browser. The plugin never reads or stores your Basecamp tokens.
